ZERO_COORDINATE.description: Coordinates are exactly 0/0, often indicating an actual null coordinate.

COUNTRY_COORDINATE_MISMATCH.description: The interpreted occurrence coordinates fall outside of the indicated country.

COORDINATE_INVALID.description: A coordinate value is given in some form, but GBIF is unable to interpret it.

COORDINATE_OUT_OF_RANGE.description: The supplied coordinates lie outside of the range for decimal lat/lon values (-90/90, -180/180).

GEODETIC_DATUM_ASSUMED_WGS84.description: If the datum is null, data interpretation assumes the record coordinates are in WGS84.

GEODETIC_DATUM_INVALID.description: The geodetic datum given could not be interpreted.

COUNTRY_MISMATCH.description: Interpreted country for dwc:country and dwc:countryCode contradict each other.

COUNTRY_DERIVED_FROM_COORDINATES.description: The interpreted country is based on the coordinates, not the verbatim string information.

COUNTRY_INVALID.description: The dwc:ccountry or dwc:countryCode given cannot be matched to the vocabulary for country names.

CONTINENT_COUNTRY_MISMATCH.description: The interpreted continent and country do not match up.

CONTINENT_COORDINATE_MISMATCH.description: The interpreted occurrence coordinates fall outside of the indicated continent.

CONTINENT_DERIVED_FROM_COORDINATES.description: The interpreted continent is based on the coordinates, not the verbatim string information.

CONTINENT_INVALID.description: The continent given cannot be matched to the vocabulary for continent names.

COORDINATE_ROUNDED.description: The original coordinates are rounded to 6 decimals (~1m precision).

COORDINATE_REPROJECTED.description: The original coordinates were successfully reprojected from a different geodetic datum to WGS84.

COORDINATE_REPROJECTION_SUSPICIOUS.description: Indicates successful coordinate reprojection according to provided datum, but which results in a datum shift larger than 0.1 decimal degrees.

COORDINATE_REPROJECTION_FAILED.description: The given decimal latitude and longitude could not be reprojected to WGS84 based on the provided datum.

COORDINATE_UNCERTAINTY_METERS_INVALID.description: Indicates an invalid or very unlikely dwc:uncertaintyInMeters.

COORDINATE_PRECISION_INVALID.description: Indicates an invalid or very unlikely dwc:coordinatePrecision

PRESUMED_NEGATED_LONGITUDE.description: The supplied longitude value places the coordinates outside of the indicated country. Negating the longitude value would result in a country match.

PRESUMED_NEGATED_LATITUDE.description: The supplied latitude value places the coordinates outside of the indicated country. Negating the latitude value would result in a country match.

PRESUMED_SWAPPED_COORDINATE.description: Coordinates seem to be swapped when testing against the interpreted country.

DEPTH_MIN_MAX_SWAPPED.description: The values for minimum and maximum depth appear to the swapped (min > max).

DEPTH_NON_NUMERIC.description: The values for minimum and maximum depth are non-numeric values and cannot be interpreted.

DEPTH_UNLIKELY.description: The values for minimum and maximum depth are negative or higher than 11000 (Mariana Trench depth in meters).

DEPTH_NOT_METRIC.description: Set if supplied depth is not given in the metric system, for example using feet instead of meters.

ELEVATION_MIN_MAX_SWAPPED.description: The values for minimum and maximum elevation appear to the swapped (min > max).

ELEVATION_NON_NUMERIC.description: The values for minimum and maximum elevation are non-numeric values and cannot be interpreted.

ELEVATION_UNLIKELY.description: The values for minimum and maximum elevation are above the troposphere (17000 m) or below Mariana Trench (11000 m).

ELEVATION_NOT_METRIC.description: Set if supplied elevation is not given in the metric system, for example using feet instead of meters.

TAXON_MATCH_HIGHERRANK.description: The record can be matched to the GBIF taxonomic backbone at a higher rank, but not with the scientific name given.

TAXON_MATCH_NONE.description: Matching to the taxonomic backbone cannot be done because there was no match at all or several matches with too little information to keep them apart (homonyms).

TAXON_MATCH_FUZZY.description: Matching to the taxonomic backbone can only be done using a fuzzy, non exact match.

SCIENTIFIC_NAME_AND_ID_INCONSISTENT.description: The dwc:scientificName provided in the occurrence record does not precisely match the name in the registered checklist when using the dwc:scientificNameID, dwc:taxonID or dwc:taxonConceptID to look it up.

SCIENTIFIC_NAME_ID_NOT_FOUND.description: The dwc:scientificNameID matched a known pattern, but it was not found in the associated checklist.

TAXON_CONCEPT_ID_NOT_FOUND.description: The dwc:taxonConceptID matched a known pattern, but it was not found in the associated checklist.

TAXON_ID_NOT_FOUND.description: The dwc:taxonID found matched a known pattern, but it was not found in the associated checklist.

TAXON_MATCH_NAME_AND_ID_AMBIGUOUS.description: The GBIF Backbone concept was found using the dwc:scientificNameID, dwc:taxonID or dwc:taxonConceptID, but it differs from what would have been found if the classification names on the record were used.

TAXON_MATCH_SCIENTIFIC_NAME_ID_IGNORED.description: The dwc:scientificNameID was not used when mapping the record to the GBIF backbone.

TAXON_MATCH_TAXON_CONCEPT_ID_IGNORED.description: The dwc:taxonConceptID was not used when mapping the record to the GBIF backbone.

TAXON_MATCH_TAXON_ID_IGNORED.description: The dwc:taxonID was not used when mapping the record to the GBIF backbone.

TAXON_MATCH_AGGREGATE.description: Matching to the taxonomic backbone can only be done at species level, but the occurrence was in fact considered a broader species aggregate/complex.

RECORDED_DATE_INVALID.description: The recording date given cannot be intrepreted because is invalid.

RECORDED_DATE_MISMATCH.description: The recording date specified as the dwc:eventDate string and the individual dwc:year, dwc:month, dwc:day are contradicting.

RECORDED_DATE_UNLIKELY.description: The recording date (dwc:eventDate, dwc:year, dwc:month, dwc:day) is highly unlikely, falling either into the future or representing a very old date before 1600 that predates modern taxonomy.

IDENTIFIED_DATE_INVALID.description: The identification date (dwc:dateIdentified) given cannot be intrepreted because is invalid.

IDENTIFIED_DATE_UNLIKELY.description: The identification date (dwc:dateIdentified) is in the future or before Linnean times (1700).

MODIFIED_DATE_INVALID.description: A (partial) invalid modified date (dc:modified) is given.

MODIFIED_DATE_UNLIKELY.description: The modified date (dc:modified) given is in the future or predates unix time (1970).

MULTIMEDIA_DATE_INVALID.description: The creation date (dc:created) given cannot be intrepreted because is invalid.

GEOREFERENCED_DATE_INVALID.description: The dwc:georeferencedDate given cannot be intrepreted because it is invalid.

GEOREFERENCED_DATE_UNLIKELY.description: The dwc:georeferenceDate given is in the future or before Linnean times (1700).

BASIS_OF_RECORD_INVALID.description: The given dwc:basisOfRecord is impossible to interpret or very different from the recommended vocabulary.

TYPE_STATUS_INVALID.description: The given dwc:typeStatus is impossible to interpret or very different from the recommended vocabulary.

OCCURRENCE_STATUS_UNPARSABLE.description: The given dwc:occurenceStatus value (present/absent) cannot be interpreted.

AMBIGUOUS_INSTITUTION.description: The given institution matches with more than 1 GRSciColl institution.

AMBIGUOUS_COLLECTION.description: The given collection matches with more than 1 GRSciColl collection.

INSTITUTION_MATCH_NONE.description: The given institution couldn't be matched with any GRSciColl institution.

INSTITUTION_MATCH_FUZZY.description: The given institution was fuzzily matched to a GRSciColl institution.

COLLECTION_MATCH_NONE.description: The given collection couldn't be matched with any GRSciColl collection.

COLLECTION_MATCH_FUZZY.description: The given collection was fuzzily matched to a GRSciColl collection.

INSTITUTION_COLLECTION_MISMATCH.description: The collection matched doesn't belong to the institution matched.

DIFFERENT_OWNER_INSTITUTION.description: The given owner institution is different than the given institution.

INDIVIDUAL_COUNT_INVALID.description: Individual count value not parsable into a positive integer.

INDIVIDUAL_COUNT_CONFLICTS_WITH_OCCURREN.description: The values given for the individual count and for the status of the occurrence (present/absent) contradict each other (e.g. the count is 0 but the status says “present”).

OCCURRENCE_STATUS_INFERRED_FROM_INDIVIDU.description: The present/absent status of the occurrence was inferred from the individual count value

REFERENCES_URI_INVALID.description: An invalid URI is given for dc:references.

MULTIMEDIA_URI_INVALID.description: An invalid URI is given for a multimedia object (dwc:associatedMedia).

INTERPRETATION_ERROR.description: An error occurred during interpretation, leaving the record interpretation incomplete.

OCCURRENCE_STATUS_INFERRED_FROM_BASIS_OF.description: Occurrence status was inferred from basis of records.

FOOTPRINT_SRS_INVALID.description: The Footprint Spatial Reference System given could not be interpreted.

FOOTPRINT_WKT_INVALID.description: The Footprint Well-Known-Text given could not be interpreted.

FOOTPRINT_WKT_MISMATCH.description: The Footprint Well-Known-Text conflicts with the interpreted coordinates (dwc:decimalLatitude, dwcdecimalLongitude etc).

UNPARSABLE.description: The scientific name string could not be parsed at all, but appears to be a parsable name type

PARTIALLY_PARSABLE.description: The beginning of the scientific name string was parsed, but there is additional information in the string that was not understood.

PARENT_NAME_USAGE_ID_INVALID.description: The value for dwc:parentNameUsageID could not be resolved.

ACCEPTED_NAME_USAGE_ID_INVALID.description: The value for dwc:acceptedNameUsageID could not be resolved.

ORIGINAL_NAME_USAGE_ID_INVALID.description: The value for dwc:originalNameUsageID could not be resolved.

SCIENTIFIC_NAME_ASSEMBLED.description: The scientific name was assembled from the individual name parts and not given as a whole string.

CHAINED_SYNOYM.description: If a synonym points to another synonym as its accepted taxon the chain is resolved.

BASIONYM_AUTHOR_MISMATCH.description: The authorship of the original name does not match the authorship in brackets of the actual name.

PARENT_CYCLE.description: The child-parent classification resulted into a cycle that needed to be resolved/cut.

CLASSIFICATION_NOT_APPLIED.description: The denormalized classification could not be applied to the name usage.

VERNACULAR_NAME_INVALID.description: At least one part of a vernacular name attached to this taxon name could not be interpreted.

DESCRIPTION_INVALID.description: At least one description record for this taxon name could not be interpreted

DISTRIBUTION_INVALID.description: At least one species distribution record for this taxon name could not be interpreted.

SPECIES_PROFILE_INVALID.description: At least one species profile record for this taxon name could not be interpreted.

MULTIMEDIA_INVALID.description: At least one multimedia extension record attached to this taxon name could not be interpreted.

BIB_REFERENCE_INVALID.description: At least one bibliographic reference for this taxon name could not be interpreted.

ALT_IDENTIFIER_INVALID.description: At least one alternative identifier for this taxon name could not be interpreted.

BACKBONE_MATCH_NONE.description: Name usage could not be matched to the GBIF backbone.

BACKBONE_MATCH_AGGREGATE.description: Name usage could only be matched to a GBIF backbone species, but was in fact a broader species aggregate/complex.

ACCEPTED_NAME_NOT_UNIQUE.description: Synonym has a verbatim accepted name which is not unique and refers to several records.

PARENT_NAME_NOT_UNIQUE.description: Record has a verbatim parent name which is not unique and refers to several records.

ORIGINAL_NAME_NOT_UNIQUE.description: Record has a verbatim original name (basionym) which is not unique and refers to several records.

RELATIONSHIP_MISSING.description: There were problems representing all name relationships, i.e. the link to the parent, accepted and/or original name.

ORIGINAL_NAME_DERIVED.description: Record has a original name (basionym) relationship which was derived from name & authorship comparison, but did not exist explicitly in the data.

CONFLICTING_BASIONYM_COMBINATION.description: There have been more than one accepted name in a homotypical basionym group of names.

NO_SPECIES.description: The group (currently only genera are tested) are lacking any accepted species.

NAME_PARENT_MISMATCH.description: The (accepted) bi/trinomial name does not match the parent name and should be recombined into the parent genus/species.

ORTHOGRAPHIC_VARIANT.description: An entry in the backbone is suspected to be only a spelling variation of an otherwise existing name.

HOMONYM.description: A not synonymized homonym exists for this name in some other backbone source which have been ignored at build time.

PUBLISHED_BEFORE_GENUS.description: A bi/trinomial name published earlier than the parent genus was published. This might indicate that the name should rather be a recombination.

CLASSIFICATION_RANK_ORDER_INVALID.description: The given ranks of the names in the classification hierarchy do not follow the hierarchy of ranks.
